FU-007.reason: The typed pull merge exists once, as LaravelWorkerLifecycleBase.pullAcrossTaskTypes: each type pulls only the remaining limit (optionally capped by the slice limit), and a later type's failure keeps the tasks already claimed (their leases are not dropped). The Bing worker's private copy is deleted and SimpleWorkerRuntimeBase delegates to it through the sliceLimit/onTypePulled hooks, so the 3x over-claim is gone.

FU-021.reason: start() runs through an AsyncOperationController (PromiseController.run returns the in-flight promise), so a watchdog resume and a user Start share one startOnce and the worker is registered once.

FU-034.reason: fetchRemoteImageBytes applies one AbortSignal.timeout (15 s) over headers and body, checks Content-Length, and caps the streamed bytes at 8 MiB; it returns null on timeout or oversize, so the worker moves on to the next candidate. bytesToBase64 replaces the byte loop; the raster magic check is centralized in isRasterImageBytes (reused by assist-image-api); web-search-cover-cache drops its own unbounded fetch.

FU-041.reason: generateOnce calls geminiImageTool.cancel(jobId, reason) whenever no image was collected. cancel() marks the job failed and navigates its tab to a fresh chat before the mutex is released, so a late image cannot be taken by the next job's baseline.
